<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary deadlock:</strong> The Congress party has raised concerns over an unprecedented 88-day delay in concluding the monsoon session, alleging a deliberate political strategy by the BJP.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxORWNObGtqOEo2RE1nbWpsMC1ycFBlZ291enIwRllPQlk2aDZaejVKWlJrdVlKbktaY3czY3BqXzFUczMwZ2sxYlpMUHM5cExLcnpsR1FQVmM5Zk9oMy1LYlpnTUZmVmFxNGYyMnFYcnZZMFNka1o5MzNidlRISW9fMllDZ2R1aERPUHozaVhMZlA2bXhfZGJuXw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election integrity and challenges:</strong> The Supreme Court is reviewing a plea regarding Election Commission processes, while the ECI has tightened neutrality rules for retired officials in poll-bound states amid reports of vote-count discrepancies in past elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxONlRsMmdYMUxqUGgtR0N4bGNLUkZUa3NDbEtXNFdUV084MU9KVTBoNzBTRGdBNE5GOXlGakZ5TjJQN2lGLXgyc2dvU01qTkxTR25mUDk5dmN6Z1l1c3FkMmRXcElweVl6TnFHRWhwTG0wS3ZxN2lxYXRBMHdaOHZzLUdIa2w5cC1ZNTV1d3l1YnY0TkZVb3RqMjlOTHlTN2dENmdwS2pnM1Y?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxNeVFMOFJBT0lxZDJoVnN3Vzl2Q0NjdHpWTjdjZXFkNUlpa3FhZnppWktjRzd2NGNpY1lZRFlkUnFRMTdhYzZycFdZNGlXcGl6WVJGaHdYbkw1eVdoME1adnM1bW9oZS05NWNISDI2dWxRUXBTYjhNdVBBelAtQU4tQ1FqbHd4MWFzS3c4NkRObE9McTdYZTNpZEFNTUlYN0FkbHNJR2xLNml5QQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political discourse:</strong> The BJP has dismissed Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi’s challenge for a public debate with the Prime Minister, asserting that Parliament remains the only appropriate forum for such discourse.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOQTBjWWZzdWhmSlh6b0JoNXk2TWw4dGJQcjFYcGRLSjFmMHNEeVJsUFNFU2Z3NEp6M2JQaF9kektWRDZmOEJHd2NGZUFyM2twdmtZamk5YlVvczM2UVpJNGVZZGQ4T1hoeDNVcUpjWkNJLUw4cGQ4REpqUXgydWJScjNxaWJTTWNUQzI3Y2RRTUs2TWU3NUg5RWdYWFZkUUNrN0N2WHFjd0xaSEIwQzRHOFdVekNwT0pQeUgxODg1dnVkdFVOaU9ZajJvVWQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial mandates:</strong> The Supreme Court has ordered Delhi-NCR authorities to submit a time-bound action plan for vehicular pollution and directed WhatsApp to formulate strategies to combat digital arrest scams.</li>
  <li><strong>Institutional accountability:</strong> The Supreme Court ruled that government-controlled bodies cannot use their &quot;society&quot; status to evade constitutional scrutiny, while also clarifying legal standards for the retirement of government employees.</li>
</ul>
